title: Attestation-Aware Scheduling for Verifiable AI Placement on SEV-SNP Confidential Kubernetes Nodes — Reproducibility Artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for "Attestation-Aware Scheduling for Verifiable AI Placement on SEV-SNP Confidential Kubernetes Nodes". Contains the reference implementation (scheduler, central verifier, node attestation agent and offline placement-token verifier), deployment chart, experimental harnesses, archived AKS data, reference figures and CSV tables, analysis scripts, and reproduction documentation. Version 1.0.1 contains software and experimental data; the article manuscript PDF and LaTeX sources are excluded. AKS data concerns node-level AMD SEV-SNP placement; kind/KWOK data is regression evidence only. The shared Go module includes auxiliary platform components outside the article scope. See README.md and ARTIFACT_VALIDATION.md for commands, provenance and validation limitations.
